title: INFORM-CT: INtegrating LLMs and VLMs FOR Incidental Findings Management in Abdominal CT
abstract: arXiv:2512.14732v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Incidental findings in CT scans, though often benign, can have significant clinical implications and should be reported following established guidelines. Traditional manual inspection by radiologists is time-consuming and variable. This paper proposes a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and foundational vision-language models (VLMs) in a plan-and-execute agentic approach to improve the efficiency and precision of incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting for abdominal CT scans. Given medical guidelines for abdominal organs, the process of managing incidental findings is automated through a planner-executor framework. The planner, based on LLM, generates Python scripts using predefined base functions, while the executor runs these scripts to perform the necessary checks and detections, via VLMs, segmentation models, and image processing subroutines. translated_title: INFORM-CT：整合大语言模型与视觉语言模型用于腹部CT偶然发现的管理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.14732v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：CT扫描中的偶然发现虽然通常为良性，但可能具有重要的临床意义，应遵循既定指南进行报告。传统上，放射科医生的人工检查耗时且存在变异性。本文提出了一种新颖框架，利用大语言模型（LLMs）和基础视觉语言模型（VLMs），采用“规划-执行”的智能体方法，以提高腹部CT扫描中偶然发现检测、分类和报告的效率和精度。针对腹部器官的医学指南，偶然发现的管理过程通过规划器-执行器框架实现自动化。规划器基于大语言模型，使用预定义基础函数生成Python脚本，而执行器运行这些脚本，通过视觉语言模型、分割模型和图像处理子程序执行必要的检查和检测。我们展示了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型和视觉语言模型的“规划-执行”智能体框架，自动化腹部CT偶然发现的检测、分类和报告流程，以提高效率和精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a plan-and-execute agentic framework integrating LLMs and VLMs to automate incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting in abdominal CT, improving efficiency and precision.
